title: pinus kesiya subsp. langbianensis
intro: Pinus kesiya subsp. langbianensis, commonly known as the Langbian pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to Vietnam and Laos. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The Langbian pine is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing and anti-cancer properties due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The exact bioactive constituents of Pinus kesiya subsp. langbianensis and its therapeutic effects are still being researched and documented.
